is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions the presence of L1014F kdr resistance in the study area (page 2), but it does not report any new genotype data or frequencies for this or any other marker in the study population.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper does not provide any genotype counts or frequencies for resistance markers.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in Bouaké, Côte d'Ivoire.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an experimental hut trial.

sub_country_location.evidence: M'Bé valley near Bouaké, Côte d'Ivoire.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Study conducted from September 2008 to August 2009.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a primary experimental hut trial.

supplement.evidence: The paper does not report any genotype data, so no supplementary genotype data is missing.

assessment.summary: This paper reports on an experimental hut trial evaluating the efficacy of different pirimiphos-methyl formulations against pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles mosquitoes in Côte d'Ivoire. While it mentions the presence of kdr resistance in the study area, it does not perform or report any genotyping of resistance markers.
